row_order_preservation.policy: SECOM has no explicit sample ID. Feature rows and label rows are aligned only by original row order after verifying equal row counts.

feature_naming.source_column_index_policy: Store the original zero-based source column index in feature-quality inventory.

missing_value_interpretation.meaning: Missing process measurement value from the source matrix.
missing_value_interpretation.imputation_policy: No imputation in v1.4.3; any future imputation must be train-only within validation folds.

duplicate_policy.exact_feature_duplicates: Report compact counts and keep source rows.
duplicate_policy.conflicting_target_duplicates: Report count and stop before modeling if nonzero.

chronological_ordering_policy.analysis_rank: Compute chronological_rank after alignment using observation_timestamp then source_order_index.
chronological_ordering_policy.primary_validation: Only chronological or blocked time splits may be considered primary; random split is not primary evidence.

stop_conditions: Feature and label row counts mismatch.
Timestamp parse ambiguity or parse failure cannot be resolved with the explicit day-first format.
Source file SHA256 changes before/after processing.
Tracked output includes credentials or absolute local paths.
limitations: SECOM lacks explicit equipment, lot, product, and recipe identifiers.
SECOM has no specification limits, so Cp/Cpk/Pp/Ppk are not ready.
Timestamps are test-point timestamps and may not represent complete longitudinal equipment history.
Failure/pass subgroup missingness summaries are descriptive and must not be used as feature selection criteria.
